### 🟢 Approval recommended The fix is a minimal, self-contained correction to one pure display helper with an unchanged return type, verified safe for all callers and backed by a proof-of-red regression test. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR fixes a display bug (#8595) in `modelChoices`, the shared store-core helper that builds the model-picker label list for both the dashboard and the mobile app. When two custom targets from different families shared both a base label and a pinned-version descriptor (e.g. `alpha → claude-alpha-1-0` and `beta → claude-beta-1-0`, both labelled `Custom`), the final collision fallback mistakenly read the already-augmented label (`Custom (pinned 1.0)`) as the base, producing doubled parentheticals like `Custom (pinned 1.0) (claude-alpha-1-0)`. **Changes:** - Each intermediate choice now carries its original `base` label alongside the augmented `choice` row, so the final collision fallback restarts from the base label and emits a single discriminator (`Custom (claude-alpha-1-0)`). - The public return type (`ModelInfo[]`), selection IDs, and full IDs are untouched, and input rows are not mutated. - Added a cross-family collision regression test plus a control verifying the pinned descriptor is retained when it alone disambiguates. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | packages/​store-core/​src/​model-display.ts | Wraps each choice as `{ base, choice }` so the final fallback uses the original base label instead of the augmented one, fixing the repeated-descriptor output. | | packages/​store-core/​src/​model-display.test.ts | Adds a cross-family collision regression (one discriminator, no `pinned`, IDs preserved, input unmutated) and a control keeping the pinned descriptor when it alone disambiguates. |
Review effort: Balanced
